question_text: A 62-year-old woman is brought to the physician because of 6 months of progressive weakness in her arms and legs. Deep tendon reflexes are 1+ in the right upper and lower extremities, 3+ in the left upper extremity, and 4+ in the left lower extremity. Sensation to light touch, pinprick, and vibration are intact.
